caseResolution.repository:*: packages/coding-agent/test/native-repository-extension-preservation.test.ts#<entry.id> selected deterministic behavior, in each dialect
caseResolution.example:*: packages/coding-agent/test/native-example-extension-preservation.test.ts#<entry.id> selected deterministic behavior, in each dialect unless the exact override below applies
caseResolution.example:dynamic-tools-echo: dynamic-tools actual session handler registers and executes echo_session
caseResolution.example:dynamic-resources-paths: dynamic-resources returns actual shipped skill, prompt and theme paths
caseResolution.example:provider-payload-log: provider-payload appends only synthetic request and response data to isolated cwd
caseResolution.example:message-renderer-fallback: message-renderer runs its real plain-content fallback without a terminal
caseResolution.example:event-bus-delivery: event-bus delivers a real command event once and disposal removes the listener
caseResolution.builtin:safety-order-and-block: safety precedes user short-circuit handlers and blocks without executing a command
caseResolution.builtin:user-todo-precedence: a real user todo factory suppresses fallback update_todo before and after reload
caseResolution.builtin:identical-call-cap: identical-loop blocks its sixth call through the actual runner
caseResolution.builtin:pair-repair: pair repair runs via the actual context hook without mutating its input
caseResolution.builtin:model-prompt-hooks: DeepSeek and model preset prompt hooks execute without any provider call
caseResolution.builtin:goal-empty-status: goal command reports no durable goal from an isolated empty project
caseResolution.builtin:opt-in-handler-toggles: opt-in deliverable and finish factories register their enabled lifecycle families
caseResolution.builtin:memory-local-status: Tencent memory status is local, unconfigured, non-capturing and not connection verification
caseResolution.fileReferences: Existing test-file references are family leads until the exact file is run. A file-level pass never certifies unexercised entry features. No live-provider or child-agent smoke is implied.
